role: Target task: when the entity's revenge timer changes it targets whoever hurt it, and with callsForHelp every same-kind creature nearby also targets the attacker.

members.name: entityCallsForHelp
members.note: ai_task.calls_for_help; the zombie passes true, the skeleton/creeper/witch false

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: AIC_HURT_BY_TARGET case: revengeTimer != last and the AITarget passes ai_is_suitable_target

members.name: startExecuting
members.note: setAttackTarget(getAITarget), saves the revenge timer, and the callsForHelp loop over same-kind creatures with a null attack target; the dropped isOnSameTeam check is always true without teams, so it is exact

notes: continueExecuting and updateTask are EntityAIBase defaults and are folded into EntityAITarget's native continue path (AIC_HURT_BY_TARGET shares the AIC_NEAREST_ATTACKABLE_TARGET case).
